messages:
claire: Hey finance - vendor for the conference shuttle charged a separate 'service surcharge' of $14.50 on top of the corpcard booking. I attached the invoice in Ramp: https://ramp.app/receipts/shuttle-176701 (screenshot attached). The booking was made on the company card but the surcharge appears as a second line item from a different merchant ID.

dan: Do we have an itemized invoice from the shuttle vendor showing the surcharge breakdown? If not, we need manager approval to reimburse or we dispute with the payment processor.

claire: The vendor sent a PDF that lists: Shuttle fare $120.00, Service surcharge $14.50, City congestion fee $2.00, Total $136.50. PDF attached to Ramp. Merchant name on the corpcard statement is 'SHUTTLEBOOKING INC' but the surcharge line posts as 'PAYMENTSVIA XFER'.

expenses-bot: For split merchant postings we require either: 1) vendor-supplied itemized invoice confirming both lines belong to same booking, or 2) manager attestation authorizing reimbursement of the surcharge if vendor cannot supply clarifying docs. We can also open a merchant inquiry to pull the original authorization details.

dan: Claire, can you ask the vendor for a short email confirming the surcharge is part of your booking and not a separate purchase? If they confirm, finance will reconcile and link both lines. If they don't, we'll escalate to payments.

claire: emailed vendor; they replied: "Confirming service surcharge $14.50 belongs to booking ref R-3342. Apologies for the merchant ID mismatch." I uploaded the vendor email to Ramp.

finance_ops: Received vendor confirmation and invoice. We'll match the two lines and process full reimbursement to the corpcard charge. Filing merchant inquiry closed. Expect reconciliation reflected in next statement.

claire: thank you! saved me a dispute call.

expenses-bot: Note for records: please keep vendor confirmation and PDF together in Ramp. This thread will be retained for audits.
